description: Sessions people had with the published agent, newest first: when, how many turns, the first thing the user asked, which topics and tools fired, and how the session ended. Read-only. Needs a cached cs_login. Use it to find the session behind a bad answer, then cs_get_transcript for the full turn list.

botId.description: Agent (bot) id. Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_AGENT_ID.

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

days.description: Only sessions from the last N days

environmentId.description: Power Platform environment id (GUID). Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_ENVIRONMENT_ID.

outcome.description: Only sessions that ended this way

search.description: Only sessions whose first user message contains this text

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_list_transcripts
title: List conversation transcripts
